title: Rules catalog
description: The rules a stack pack defines. Findings refer to rules by id.

defaults.description: Settings shared by the rules of the catalog.

files.description: Files of rules that do not set their own.

ignoreLines.description: Patterns matched from the first code token of a line; the lines they match are skipped by every rule of the catalog.

severity.description: Default severity; criteria may say more. A rule that needs judgement still declares it, as the severity the judgement starts from.

needsJudgement.description: True if the rule only points at code to look at: its signals carry no severity, and the judgement decides whether there is a finding and how serious it is.

description.description: What the rule checks and why, in Markdown.

why.description: Consequence written into the findings made from the rule's signals: what goes wrong if the code ships as it is, in one sentence of Markdown. Required when the rule has match and does not need judgement; otherwise the judgement writes the text.

fix.description: Smallest safe correction written into the findings made from the rule's signals, in one sentence of Markdown. Required when the rule has match and does not need judgement; otherwise the judgement writes the text.

languages.description: Languages the rule applies to; empty means all languages of the pack.

group.description: Section heading under which the rule is listed in the checklist generated from the catalog; rules with the same group are listed together, in catalog order. Absent: the rule is listed without a heading.

when.description: Conditions for the rule to apply to a repository; all must hold. profile lists the profiles; any other key is a dimension of the pack and lists its values. Absent: the rule always applies.

additionalProperties.description: Values of the dimension named by the key, one of which the repository must have.

match.description: What the rule matches mechanically. Absent: the rule is only judged, never matched.

dimensionId.description: Identifier of a dimension or of one of its values: lowercase words joined by hyphens.

element.description: One element of a token pattern: a token, a gap, a repeated group, or alternatives.

kind.description: Kind, or kinds, the token must have. Absent: any kind.

oneOf.description: Texts, one of which the token must have.

regexp.description: RE2 regular expression the text of the token must contain a match of; anchor it to match the whole text. At most one of text, oneOf and regexp.

at.description: True on the token the signal points at; by default, the first token of the match. At most one per pattern.

gap.description: Skips as few tokens as needed for the rest of the pattern to match.

balanced.description: True if the skipped tokens must open and close the brackets of the lexer table in pairs; the gap then never goes past a closing bracket it did not open.

stopAt.description: Tokens the gap may not skip.

repeat.description: A group of elements matched between min and max times, as many as possible.

max.description: Most repetitions of repeat. Absent: no limit.

anyOf.description: Alternative sequences of elements, tried in order.

files.description: Which files a rule runs on. All conditions must hold.

include.description: Globs; the file must match one. Absent: every file of the rule languages.

exclude.description: Globs the file must not match.

tests.description: skip: not on the test files of the pack manifest; include: on every file; only: only on test files.

contains.description: Patterns, one of which must match somewhere in the file.

notContains.description: Patterns none of which may match anywhere in the file.

glob.description: Path glob with forward slashes: '*' matches within a segment, '**' matches any number of segments.

languageId.description: Language identifier, as in the languages of the pack manifest.

lexerBracket.description: A single punctuation character: not blank, not a letter, digit or underscore.

match.description: What a rule matches mechanically: token patterns or one generic detector on each file, or, with scope change-request, one detector on the whole change request.

scope.description: change-request: the detector sees the whole change request (its changed files, their contents at base and at head, the repository tree at head, a code search, and the change requests above it in the cascade) instead of one file. Absent: one file at a time.

patterns.description: Token patterns; a match of any of them is a signal.

exclude.description: Patterns that cancel a signal whose token lies inside one of their matches.

files.description: Which files the rule runs on; replaces the files of the catalog defaults.

lines.description: all: signals on any line; added: only on lines the change request adds.

detector.description: A generic detector instead of token patterns. On each file, line-length: lines longer than max runes; missing-doc: declarations at top level or directly in a type body with no doc comment right before them. On the change request (scope change-request), missing-test: an added or modified source whose test is neither in the change request nor under a test root of its module; counterpart: a changed file whose counterpart in another group exists and is not changed; symbol-usage: a public symbol the change request removes, or gives a new required parameter, that the repositories of the change requests above it in the cascade still use; expect-actual: an expect declaration added or changed in the common group with no matching actual in a platform group of its module.

max.description: line-length: longest allowed line, in runes, line break excluded.

declarations.description: missing-doc: words that start a declaration.

modifiers.description: missing-doc: words that may come between the annotations and the declaration word.

skipModifiers.description: missing-doc: modifiers that exempt the declaration.

types.description: missing-doc: declaration words that open a type, whose body holds members.

notAfter.description: missing-doc: punctuation after which a type word does not declare a type, for example ::.

annotation.description: missing-doc: punctuation that starts an annotation, for example @.

skipAnnotations.description: missing-doc: annotation names that exempt the declaration.

header.description: missing-doc: brackets of the header of a type, whose contents are not members.

sources.description: missing-test: globs of the source files that need a test.

nameSuffixes.description: missing-test: endings of the file name, extension excluded, that make a source need a test, for example ViewModel.

moduleSeparator.description: missing-test: path fragment that ends the module part of a source path, for example src/main/; the test roots are relative to what comes before it.

testRoots.description: missing-test: directories, relative to the module, where the tests of its sources live, for example src/test.

testName.description: missing-test: file name of the test, extension excluded, where {name} stands for the name of the source, for example {name}Test.

testExtensions.description: missing-test: extensions a test file may have, for example .kt.

groups.description: counterpart: the groups, as they appear in paths, for example androidMain and iosMain; exactly one of groups and groupsFrom. expect-actual: the platform groups that need an actual when the module has files in them.

groupsFrom.description: counterpart: where the groups come from instead of groups. config.variants: the variants of the repository configuration; the rule is skipped when there are fewer than two.

groupPattern.description: counterpart and expect-actual: how a group appears in a path, with {group} standing for it, for example src/{group}/. A file is under a group when its path contains the pattern at the start of a segment; what comes before is its module.

stripSuffixes.description: counterpart: endings removed from a file name, before its extension, when comparing paths across groups, for example .android so that Foo.android.kt and Foo.ios.kt are counterparts.

symbolChange.description: symbol-usage: which change of a public symbol is checked. removed: the symbol is gone at head; required-parameter: a function has, at head, a parameter without a default whose name it did not have at base.

expectKeyword.description: expect-actual: modifier of a declaration that needs an actual in every platform group, for example expect.

actualKeyword.description: expect-actual: modifier of the declaration that provides it, for example actual.

commonGroup.description: expect-actual: the group whose expect declarations are checked, for example commonMain.

intermediateGroups.description: expect-actual: platform groups that are intermediate source sets, each with the target groups below it, for example iosMain with iosArm64Main and iosX64Main. When the intermediate group has files at head, it must hold the actual; when it has none, each of its target groups with files must. Every key must be one of groups; a target group is not one of groups.

additionalProperties.description: The target groups below the intermediate group.

packId.description: Stack pack identifier, for example android or kotlin-multiplatform.

pattern.description: A sequence of elements matched against consecutive code tokens of a file.

languages.description: Languages the pattern applies to, among those of the rule. Absent: all of them.

profile.description: Kind of repository, which selects the default criteria.

ruleId.description: Rule identifier: lowercase words joined by hyphens, optionally in dot-separated groups, for example no-double-bang.

severity.description: Severity of a finding, from the most to the least serious.

tokenKind.description: Kind of a code token: identifier, keyword, word (an identifier or a keyword, soft keywords included), number, string, raw-string, char, punct, or any. Comments are never matched.

tokenMatcher.description: Conditions on one token; all must hold.

kind.description: Kind, or kinds, the token must have. Absent: any kind.

oneOf.description: Texts, one of which the token must have.

regexp.description: RE2 regular expression the text of the token must contain a match of; anchor it to match the whole text. At most one of text, oneOf and regexp.
